exact_source_value_retrieval.ready: all eligible final direct/temporal/narrow-claim samples correct, attribution 1, complete required fields 1; oracle-structured only

independent_reproducibility.ready: frozen dataset/config/reference hashes hold, second automated full replay and partial resume produce identical canonical results and metric aggregates

multi_source_completeness.ready: all required evidence facets retrievable for >=95% final multi-source questions; action/clock facets count separately

natural_language_evidence_retrieval.ready: at least one existing NL mode reaches all thresholds on answerable final cases, with supplied scope; no claim of autonomous intent parsing

physical_interpretation.ready: all requested positive physical properties verified; conditional/unavailable clocks/world transforms cannot be promoted

provenance_assurance.ready: all explicit assurance requests honor scope and missing historical attestation; no silent downgrade

source_integrity.ready: all scratch missing/corrupt/redirected-source challenges fail closed; no false verified result

uncertainty_abstention.ready: all explicitly unsupported typed requests reject or clearly qualify raw-only results; ambiguity without typed parsing is conditional

recommendation_rules.A: No foundational failures and NL/multi-source capabilities ready for an explicitly bounded pilot
recommendation_rules.B: Integrity/scope foundations hold but NL, completeness, interface or ambiguity blockers need focused database-only correction
recommendation_rules.C: Foundational source integrity, scope isolation or false-assurance failures remain unmet

rubric: External deterministic narrow-fact rubric only. No production sufficiency classifier or safety judge is added.
